vikram: Quick RFC follow-up — we need a pragmatic plan for graceful client-envelope negotiation when we change top-level payload shape. I don't want a big client migration headache. proposing a tiny runtime shim + header sniff + per-tenant opt-in. thoughts?

sophia: +1. header sniffing sounds least invasive. what header were you thinking? X-Rw-Envelope-Version? :thinking_face:

vikram: yeah, something like X-RW-ENV-V that clients can set. fallback to content heuristics if missing. runtime rewrites only when necessary so we avoid touching client libs.

mike: prefer doing rewrites at the runtime layer (envelope-service) so we don't duplicate logic across edges. also easier to add telemetry and rate-limit rules.

jess: runtime shim + tenant opt-in flag is good. we should capture metrics: original_envelope_version, rewrite_performed, tenant_id, latency_delta. need a plan for evals so rewrites don't change semantics.

vikram: agreed. rough pseudocode for detection+rewrite:
```python
# simplified detection
ver = headers.get('X-RW-ENV-V')
if ver == 'v2':
    # client is explicit, pass-through expected shape
    accept_v2(body)
else:
    # header absent => heuristics
    if 'messages' in body and not 'prompt' in body:
        # looks like new envelope, rewrite to legacy shape for handlers
        body = transform_v2_to_v1(body)
    else:
        accept_v1(body)
```

sophia: that heuristic seems fine as a start. be careful about ambiguous payloads (small bots that send both). add a sampling/annotate path so we can inspect borderline cases.

mike: rollout plan idea: canary at 3% of traffic for region-us, collect rewrite_fail_rate, semantic_regression (via eval prompts), and latency P50/P95. if metrics look good -> 25% -> 100%.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for envelope-shim service started at 2026-03-21T10:12Z on region-us, 3% traffic.

jess: telemetry keys to add: envelope.client_header, envelope.heuristic_hit, envelope.rewrite_count, envelope.rewrite_latency_ms. and a counter for false_positive_rewrites (human-reviewed).

sophia: also add an opt-out header for safety (X-RW-ENV-SAFE=ignore-rewrite) for customers who want no mutation during testing. document it in the migration guide.

vikram: final-ish plan: implement runtime shim in envelope-service, expose tenant opt-in flag, add sampling and detailed telemetry, canary 3% now (infra-bot), expand to 25% after one week if rewrite_fail_rate < 0.5% and no eval regressions. deprecate support for implicit v1 shapes in 90 days after cutover if mismatch <1% :shipit:

mike: please add an ops runbook entry for rollback triggers (e.g., 5xx spike, rewrite_fail_rate > 2%, semantic_regressions detected).

jess: will add runbook + dashboard. also schedule an eval job to run nightly against canary traffic traces.

sophia: I'll draft the brief doc for SDK teams and external notice. include code snippet for setting X-RW-ENV-V.

vikram: sweet. thanks y'all — we avoid a heavy client churn and get observability. ping me if you want to pair on the transform tests. :eyes:
